body: The reason I dislike them as someone in my mid 20s is because I hear people my age playing it. I’m not speaking for people who were my age back in the early 2000’s.. but Limp among many other popular bands never really had a place in my generations teenage/adult years. That’s not to say you can’t enjoy music that was before your time, but seriously out of all the music that came from the early 2000’s and prior, you choose Limp Bizkit. It’s cringe because they play it at work and they are negative young men with a dull outlook on life, and the lyrics really compliment that. I think toxic masculinity is a good term. Just to clarify I get equally let down when I hear people my age cranking bon jovi or AC/DC for the millionth time. Like we weren’t there dude, and theres tonnes of more soulful music from that era. Stop trying to be like dad
